name: Bill Nye
role: Humorist whose pieces the Cow Boy reprinted
bio: Bill Nye, the nationally known humorist, appeared in the Cow Boy through reprinted sketches and sayings, including 'Broncho Sam' in February 1884. In 1886 the paper carried his comic pieces on cattle brands and on the danger of overstocking the range.
